How the chart works

What counts
A pick: someone searches Apple Music in the Now Batting song editor and chooses a song for a player. Songs added through the parent link, a roster import or a shared roster aren’t counted.
The window
Each weekly chart reflects four weeks of song selections, ending Sunday at midnight Eastern time.
How it ranks
By how many different Now Batting users picked a song. Picking it for five players still counts once, so one very busy team can’t carry a song. Ties go to total picks, then to the most recent week. A song needs at least 3 users to chart.
Versions
A single, an album cut and a clean edit of the same song count together, and the row links to the version picked most. Explicit versions aren’t counted or shown.
When it updates
Every Monday morning. “Last week” compares against the previous Monday’s chart; a song’s first appearance is marked NEW, a return is RE-ENTRY.
Weeks on the chart
Counts every weekly chart a song has made. A plus, like “5+ weeks”, means the song was already on our earliest chart, so it may have been charting longer than our records go back.
Privacy
We publish rankings only. No counts, no player or team names, nothing about who picked what.
